description: Bot simulation (docs/research/economy-six-chains.md): a settlement set up at the start, then no orders for the given days. Run by tests/Core.Tests/Simulation/BotSimulationTests.cs; golden CSVs bot_<residents>.csv.

build.description: Building demand variant (golden bot_build_<residents>.csv): every everyTicks ticks the bot upgrades its finished buildings up to upgradeTo, places one new near the center while fewer than keep would stand, and demolishes those at upgradeTo; a demolition refunds only part of the cost, so wood and stone keep being spent.
